Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a hyperechoic, cystic mass in the fetal right hemithorax (indicated by arrows) with visible systemic arterial supply on color Doppler, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM. Such lesions typically cause mass effect, displacing the mediastinum/heart to the contralateral side and elevating the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm, which aligns with the description in option B.
